title: A Modular Form Proof of the Irrationality of $ζ\left(3\right)$
summary: We present an expository proof of the irrationality of $ζ\left(3\right)$ using modular forms of level 6. By constructing a suitable Eichler integral, we obtain a power series with controlled denominators and sufficiently large radius of convergence. Beukers' irrationality criterion then implies that $ζ\left(3\right)$ is irrational.
